title: Rise of Industry MCP observer.config.json
description: Optional user configuration of the observer (PRD 8.7), at %LOCALAPPDATA%\RoiMcp\observer.config.json. Every field is optional. Out-of-range values are clamped and unknown fields are ignored, both with a warning in the heartbeat (config_warnings). No key can affect the compatibility gate: capture on a non-baseline game build is impossible in V1.

enabled.description: false puts the observer in the disabled state (heartbeat only)
